features: Storm Infinity max delivers a battery time of upto 20 days thanks to its 680 mAh battery.

AI-Based Health Nudges: Storm Infinity Max brings intelligent, personalised nudges that actually learn from you. Its advanced AI algorithms track your movement, sleep, and daily habits to deliver meaningful recommendations right when you need them. It gets smarter with every move, adapting to your lifestyle in real time.

2.01" Display: Crushing screen size expectations again, this smartwatch features a massive 2.01” HD display—the largest ever among smartwatches. With a raise-to-wake gesture, your notifications, workouts, and calls are always just a flick away—even under bright sunlight.

Wellness Balance Score: After 2 weeks of consistent activity, your watch begins delivering a daily wellness score that reflects your physical and emotional well-being. It's your personal wellness dashboard—built from your own activity, sleep, heart rate, and SpO2 patterns.
